# Screenberry Knowledge Base

Text-only product knowledge. Public default: 3.4; 3.5 is in development. Imported records are in_review. Use explicit version/profile selection. Search knowledge/ for guide answers. For implementation questions, explicitly select the separately scoped 3.5.0 beta source supplement below; source-confirmed does not mean runtime-verified or applicable to 3.4. Preserve fact boundaries and provenance. illustrations/ contains optional User Guide editorial briefs, not factual evidence. No binary media or Screenberry source is bundled.
